"High Availability (HA) & Data Sync Module" & "POC prerequisites  for SQ Alert 
Plus" for your end to run in any LLM to learn more  : 
 
Theme: Installation / Setup  
 
Question: Can setup of High Availability (HA) / Clustering in 2 different physical locations - focus 
on HA & Data Sync Module?  
Answer: HA solution does not apply when two sites are of two different networks linked by a 
leased line and no VPN. Both are in different subnets but connected: cannot use  HA, but use data 
sync . This means both are running independently, but data is synced in real -time. So, the 
application can send to 1 system and load balance to another, possibly using a load balancer for 
auto -distribution.  
 SMS message sending by primary will be copied over secondary, and both sides will have the 
same data in usage logs. The setup has to be in the same subnet mask range for the heartbeat 
connection for Eth -1. SendQuick HA failover on VM will take about 5 -6 se conds. Refer to the 
YouTube link below: https://youtu.be/Dn8v1eB62t4 . Alerts will be lost in 5 seconds since there 
was no package drop in the ping check.
